title: Metal Album of the Week: 12/8
contentHtml:
Creature by Within The Ruins 

Creature by Within The Ruins was released in the year 2009 and is some of the finest deathcore to this day. Within The Ruins is going on tour with Currents in New England starting February 10th with 4 dates starting in Stanhope, NJ and ending in Clifton Park, NY on the 14th. 
Listen to Creature here or buy it on iTunes today! 
​https://play.spotify.com/album/1PmK4O4SFR6qLE1FEhydsw
